dialogues.speaker: Wakui
dialogues.jp:
「――と言うように、日本の風習や慣わし、身
　近な決まりごとなどは、全て中国から伝わっ
　た陰陽五行の影響を――」
dialogues.en:
「--In other words, in accordance with old Japanese customs,
all events can be predicted using an ancient Chinese ritual
of--
dialogues.text:
「--In other words, in accordance with old Japanese customs,
all events can be predicted using an ancient Chinese ritual
of--

dialogues.speaker: Wakui
dialogues.jp:
「最近、若者の間で｛あべのせいめい／安倍晴明｝が流行っているよ
　うだが、いかんせん、陰陽道そのものの伝わ
　り方が全く間違って――」
dialogues.en:
"Recently, a young man by the name of Abe Seimei brought
forth the theory that the way of the yin and yang is--"
dialogues.text:
"Recently, a young man by the name of Abe Seimei brought
forth the theory that the way of the yin and yang is--"

dialogues.speaker: Wakui
dialogues.jp:
「そもそも陰陽道は呪いであるのと同時に、当
　時の最先端の科学でもあったわけだ。これは
　西洋の錬金術と――」
dialogues.en:
"In the first place, Onmyoudou was a blessing and a curse at
the same time, which the western world called "Alchemy"--
dialogues.text:
"In the first place, Onmyoudou was a blessing and a curse at
the same time, which the western world called "Alchemy"--

dialogues.jp:
見下ろしたノートには、ここが魔法学院ではな
いかと思われるような記述が記されている。
dialogues.en:
As I look over my written notes, I try to remember whether
magic courses was anywhere in this school's description.
dialogues.text:
As I look over my written notes, I try to remember whether
magic courses was anywhere in this school's description.

dialogues.jp: 「……なぁ眞子よ」
dialogues.en: "...Hey, Mako."
dialogues.text: "...Hey, Mako."

dialogues.jp:
小声で、近くの席でシャーペンで遊んでいた眞
子に声をかける。
dialogues.en:
I gave a little whisper to Mako, playing with the sharpener
on her desk.
dialogues.text:
I gave a little whisper to Mako, playing with the sharpener
on her desk.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なによ？」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「長いな……」
dialogues.en: "This is getting long..."
dialogues.text: "This is getting long..."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「仕方ないじゃない……先生、チャイムのこと
　なんて気にしちゃいないんだから」
dialogues.en:
"Nothing we can do about it... I don't think sensei heard
the chime awhile ago."
dialogues.text:
"Nothing we can do about it... I don't think sensei heard
the chime awhile ago."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「いや、それはいい。ただ俺は和久井講師の授
　業を丸一年受けたんだが、時折あの人の担当
　科目を忘れることがある」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I suppose it's only fair. I've certainly forgotten
plenty of things about his lectures."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I suppose it's only fair. I've certainly forgotten
plenty of things about his lectures."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……教えてあげるから覚えておきなさい」
dialogues.en:
"......Thanks for telling me that, I'd be sure to remember
it."
dialogues.text:
"......Thanks for telling me that, I'd be sure to remember
it."

dialogues.jp:
チラリ、と陶酔した語りの和久井講師に、眞子
の視線が突き刺さる。
dialogues.en:
By accident, Wakui's gaze met Mako's while he scanned the
room, intoxicated in his own lesson.
dialogues.text:
By accident, Wakui's gaze met Mako's while he scanned the
room, intoxicated in his own lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Wakui
dialogues.jp:
「ホムンクルスと式神は同一のように思われる
　が、東西で神の認識が違うことを見ても分か
　るように――」
dialogues.en:
"Homonculus share similar properties with ceremonial Gods,
although they are not the Gods we refer to..."
dialogues.text:
"Homonculus share similar properties with ceremonial Gods,
although they are not the Gods we refer to..."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「――科学と物理と忍耐よ」
dialogues.en: "...Science, physics, and endurance all in one."
dialogues.text: "...Science, physics, and endurance all in one."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……腹減った」
dialogues.en: "...I'm hungry."
dialogues.text: "...I'm hungry."

dialogues.jp:
その１０分ほど後、物理と科学の申し子である
和久井講師は、満面の笑みで教室を去った。
dialogues.en:
After 10 more minutes, God's gift to science and physics,
Wakui, left the classroom with a smile that showed on his
whole face.
dialogues.text:
After 10 more minutes, God's gift to science and physics,
Wakui, left the classroom with a smile that showed on his
whole face.

dialogues.jp:
『今のところは３日後のテストに出るぞ』
――と、恐ろしい捨て台詞を残して。
dialogues.en:
"The test for this subject will be in 3 days time!" --Were
the horrifying words he left behind.
dialogues.text:
"The test for this subject will be in 3 days time!" --Were
the horrifying words he left behind.

dialogues.speaker: Class
dialogues.en: "...Groaaan."
dialogues.text: "...Groaaan."

dialogues.jp: ◆長い和久井の授業◆
dialogues.en: ◆Long-winded Wakui's Lesson◆
dialogues.text: ◆Long-winded Wakui's Lesson◆

dialogues.jp:
和久井の授業は長いなあ……。陰陽道がどうの
こうの……。
dialogues.en:
Wakui's lesson was super-long... talking this and that about
Onmyoudou...
dialogues.text:
Wakui's lesson was super-long... talking this and that about
Onmyoudou...
